visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A silver-haired man in a black t-shirt and white pants stands holding several shopping bags and a yellow umbrella. A woman wearing a grey long-sleeved athletic top and leggings sits on a wooden chair nearby. A second woman in a white top and black shorts sits on a bench in the background of a studio-like room with lockers. (2) A hand enters from the right side of the frame and hands a white package with the brand name 'COEGG' to the woman in the grey outfit. She takes it with a smile. (3) The woman in grey stands up and delivers a high kick to the man's groin area. This action is edited with multiple jump cuts and speed ramps, looping the kick several times with flashy white-light transitions. (4) The man is now seen sitting on a bench looking pained, while the woman in grey stands and talks to him aggressively, pointing her finger. Yellow and white captions appear on the screen. (5) The woman in the white top on the bench gets up and walks away out of the frame. The woman in grey then turns to the camera, holding the white 'COEGG' package and speaking directly to the audience with enthusiastic gestures. (6) The man stands up and lifts his shirt to reveal the red waistband of his underwear with the white 'COEGG' logo clearly visible. (7) The woman in grey kicks him one more time, and they both break into laughter at the end of the scene.

(2) A sudden percussive 'thud' SFX sounds as the electronic dance music BGM swells with a prominent 4/4 beat. (3) The impact SFX repeats rapidly in sync with visual loops, accompanied by sharp digital 'whoosh' transitions. (4) The woman's voice returns, now with high intensity and aggressive pitch variability, shouting at the man. (5) The music continues as the woman's tone shifts to an excited, promotional style, speaking clearly about a product with intermittent high-pitched 'ding' and 'sparkle' UI SFX. (6) A male voice enters with a calm but pained tone, which quickly turns into a confident statement about wearing a brand. (7) A final impact SFX is followed by a loud comical shout and the sound of group laughter as the music fades out.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Comedic Skit -> Product Pitch -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote COEGG brand underwear through a humorous and high-energy social media skit. The video uses a 'slapstick' comedy hook involving a man being kicked in the groin to grab attention, then pivots into explaining the product's benefits (protection and comfort) as the 'solution' to the pain shown in the comedy bit.
